newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends slightly up on late dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends slightly up on late dlr sales.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed slightly stronger after opening low on a foreign bank's aggressive dollar sales, dealers said.
The rupee ended at 57.65 to the dollar, after opening at 57.67 and closing Thursday at 57.68.
"Trading was ranged with the exchange rate moving between 57.65-57.73," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
He attributed the dollar's dip to aggressive, late dollar sales from an overseas bank.
Call money closed at 13.75 percent, after rising to 16 percent, dealers said. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
